description: InputHash: hex SHA-256 of the input's canonical JSON (internal/kit/canonical; reference: protocol/canonical.mjs, vendored from service-template): no whitespace, object keys sorted by Unicode code point, strings and numbers as ECMAScript's JSON.stringify writes them. An absent input hashes as null. Each input is written here exactly as a client might send it; canonical is what it hashes.

cases.why: an absent input hashes as null
keys sorted at every depth, arrays keep their order
numbers as JSON.stringify writes them: 1.0 is 1, 1e21 is 1e+21, -0 is 0
strings escape only ", \ and U+0000-U+001F (U+2028, <, >, & and non-ASCII stay raw); keys sort by code point (U+FF61 before U+1F600, unlike UTF-16 order)
